name: VC7d-flat-earth
old: float t = (2.0 * R * H + H * H) / (R * dir.y + sqrt(R * R * dir.y * dir.y + 2.0 * R * H + H * H));

name: VC7d-cancelling-root
old: float t = (2.0 * R * H + H * H) / (R * dir.y + sqrt(R * R * dir.y * dir.y + 2.0 * R * H + H * H));
new: float t = sqrt(R * R * dir.y * dir.y + 2.0 * R * H + H * H) - R * dir.y;

name: VC7d-no-haze
old: a *= exp(-t / ${glslF(CIRRUS_FADE_M)});   // gone into the horizon's haze
new: a *= 1.0;   // gone into the horizon's haze

name: VC7d-jet-unwrapped
old: cirrus: wrapField(minutes * CIRRUS_JET_M_PER_MINUTE),   // The jet's offset east, wrapped to the field's period - every tile the ice reads divides it
new: cirrus: minutes * CIRRUS_JET_M_PER_MINUTE,   // The jet's offset east, wrapped to the field's period - every tile the ice reads divides it

name: VC7d-jet-wrapped-short
old: cirrus: wrapField(minutes * CIRRUS_JET_M_PER_MINUTE),   // The jet's offset east, wrapped to the field's period - every tile the ice reads divides it
new: cirrus: wrap(minutes * CIRRUS_JET_M_PER_MINUTE, SHAPE_METRES * 3.3),   // The jet's offset east, wrapped to the field's period - every tile the ice reads divides it

name: VC7d-jet-steered-by-surface
old: cirrus: wrapField(minutes * CIRRUS_JET_M_PER_MINUTE),   // The jet's offset east, wrapped to the field's period - every tile the ice reads divides it
new: cirrus: wrapField(minutes * CIRRUS_JET_M_PER_MINUTE + driftWorld[0]),   // The jet's offset east, wrapped to the field's period - every tile the ice reads divides it

name: VC7d-jet-west
old: q.x -= uCirrus.z;   // the jet carries it east
new: q.x += uCirrus.z;   // the jet carries it east

name: VC7d-sharp-streaks
old: vec4 sk = textureLod(uShape, vec3(q.x / (SHAPE_M * ${glslF(CIRRUS_ALONG)}), 0.83 + uCirrus.w, (q.y + bend) / (SHAPE_M * ${glslF(CIRRUS_ACROSS)})), mip + 1.0);   // a mip soft: the volume's texels, stretched this far, jag a wisp's edge
new: vec4 sk = textureLod(uShape, vec3(q.x / (SHAPE_M * ${glslF(CIRRUS_ALONG)}), 0.83 + uCirrus.w, (q.y + bend) / (SHAPE_M * ${glslF(CIRRUS_ACROSS)})), mip);   // a mip soft: the volume's texels, stretched this far, jag a wisp's edge

name: VC7d-no-origin-shift
old: vec2 q = cam.xz + dir.xz * t + uShift;

name: VC7d-crazed
old: float streak = smoothstep(wispAt, wispAt + ${glslF(CIRRUS_WISP_SOFT)}, sk.g * 0.6 + sk.b * 0.4);

name: VC7d-no-patches
old: float patchIn = smoothstep(1.0 - uCirrus.x - 0.12, 1.0 - uCirrus.x + 0.12, patchField);

name: VC7d-fog-shows-most
old: export const CIRRUS_COVER = Object.freeze({ sunny: 0.45, cloudy: 0.5, overcast: 0.1, fog: 0.3, rain: 0.08, snow: 0.08, thunder: 0.06, sandstorm: 0.15, ashfall: 0.15 });
new: export const CIRRUS_COVER = Object.freeze({ sunny: 0.45, cloudy: 0.5, overcast: 0.1, fog: 0.9, rain: 0.08, snow: 0.08, thunder: 0.06, sandstorm: 0.15, ashfall: 0.15 });

name: VC7d-jump-keeps-old
old: jump() { this.profile = null; this.cirrusCover = null; this.fair = null; this.stripe = 0; this.shadowFull = true; }
new: jump() { this.profile = null; this.fair = null; this.stripe = 0; this.shadowFull = true; }

name: VC7d-ground-sun
old: const L = cloudLight(state, { base: CIRRUS_ALT_M, top: CIRRUS_ALT_M });

name: VC7d-sun-at-ground-elevation
old: const elev = (state.elevDeg ?? Math.asin(Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, state.sunDir[1]))) * 180 / Math.PI) + horizonDip(CIRRUS_ALT_M) * 180 / Math.PI;
new: const elev = (state.elevDeg ?? Math.asin(Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, state.sunDir[1]))) * 180 / Math.PI) + 0;

name: VC7d-no-light-upload
old: gl.uniform3fv(u.uCirrusLight, ice.color); gl.uniform3fv(u.uCirrusDir, ice.dir);   // The curtains' falls, packed with the cells this frame
new: gl.uniform3fv(u.uCirrusDir, ice.dir);   // The curtains' falls, packed with the cells this frame
